title: Dermochelys coriacea 001
author: Philippe Kurlapski
changes: Leatherback sea turtle (Dermochelys coriacea) breathing on the beach after laying eggs. Trimmed to 9.30–12.00 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
